user.title: TeslaMate MQTT Configuration
user.description:
Configure connection to TeslaMate via MQTT.

**Requirements:**
• MQTT integration must be configured first
• TeslaMate must be running and publishing to MQTT

**Finding Your Settings:**
• MQTT prefix: Check TeslaMate's MQTT_NAMESPACE env variable (default: 'teslamate')
• Car IDs: First car = 1, second car = 2, etc. Check TeslaMate web UI or MQTT topics

For detailed help, see documentation: MQTT_CONFIGURATION.md

data_description.name: Friendly name for this integration (e.g., 'My Tesla')
data_description.car_ids: Your car IDs from TeslaMate (e.g., '1' or '1,2,3')

error.mqtt_not_loaded: MQTT integration not found! Configure MQTT first: Settings → Devices & Services → Add Integration → MQTT
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to MQTT broker. Check MQTT configuration.
error.invalid_car_ids: Invalid car IDs format. Use comma-separated numbers (e.g., '1' or '1,2,3')
error.unknown: Unexpected error occurred. Check Home Assistant logs.
